title: Deployable fixed-depth-quota tree selection vs production best-first
status_before_results: preregistered; no A1 node count, coverage, Phi or gate value had been inspected

audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.budget_semantics: budget (63) counts tree nodes only; the committed root token is packed separately (packed_root_cost=1), so the packed verify pass carries 64 positions
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.depth_semantics: depth = block offset, 1..block_size-1 = 1..15; depth 0 is the committed root and is never a node
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.candidate_source: torch.topk(F.log_softmax(draft_logits.float()), branch_k=8) over the block head's per-offset marginals; top_ids/top_logp are moved to CPU and the tree is built on CPU
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.path_score: cumulative sum of per-offset marginal log-probabilities along the root-to-node path; scores of different nodes at the same depth are never combined
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.best_first: max-heap (negated score) seeded with the K depth-1 candidates; pop -> append node -> push its K children at depth+1. Ties broken by (depth, parent, rank, insertion order) through the heap tuple, i.e. insertion-order-stable.
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.verified_equivalence: re-running the untouched production builder on the persisted C6 GPU top-8 ids/logp reproduces the stored 63-node tree byte-for-byte on 48/48 C0 anchors (checked before this preregistration was written)
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.is_best_first_optimal_for_its_proxy: yes, for Phi(T) = sum over nodes of exp(cumulative path log-probability). Because log p <= 0, extending a path never increases its path probability; the best-first pop order is exactly the greedy order that maximises Phi over prefix-closed sets of the given size. Therefore A1 must NOT be described as solving the same objective better.
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.prefix_closure: children are only ever pushed from a node already appended, so the packed list is topologically ordered (parent index < child index) and prefix closed by construction
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.verifier: one ancestor-masked target pass over the packed tree (tree_mask gives each packed token the whole prefix KV plus its own ancestor chain); the commit walk follows the target's own greedy token and stops at the first missing child
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.commit_gap_identity: L_actual = L_tree for a correctly executed greedy commit walk, so a nonzero commit_gap is a correctness failure of the verifier/commit path, not a modelling result
audit_findings_recorded_before_prereg.root_bonus: root is the already-committed token; bonus is the target's token emitted after the accepted prefix and is excluded from L_raw/L_tree/L_actual

frozen_inputs.excluded: the phaseC5 B-reference first-8-rounds sample is a different anchor set and is NOT used or pooled here
frozen_inputs.candidate_rule: Stage 0 and Stage 1 use ONLY the persisted GPU top8_ids/top8_logp captured by C6. No CPU log_softmax rerun, no new head call, no top32-derived substitute.

A0.description: unmodified production best-first prefix-closed budget-63 tree; the baseline under test
A0.reference_tree: the 63 nodes persisted in the C6 trace (reconstruction must match exactly)

A1.description: fixed depth quota, prefix closed, shallow-to-deep
A1.parent_rule: a depth-d candidate may only extend a node kept at depth d-1
A1.ranking_within_depth: ascending negated cumulative path log-probability, i.e. the same cumulative score A0 ranks by; the cumulative score is the sum of the per-offset marginal log-probabilities along the path, so it is exactly comparable between candidate nodes
A1.tie_break: (1) cumulative path log-probability, (2) the parent's slot in the previous depth's kept list (root = slot 0), (3) rank within the parent's per-offset candidate row
A1.deficit_rule: if a depth has fewer legal candidates than its quota, it keeps what exists; unused quota is NEVER back-filled from a deeper depth; leftover budget is recorded

metric_definitions.L_raw: number of leading offsets (offset 1..cap) at which the correct AR reference token is inside the persisted top-8 candidate set; cap = min(15, remaining_after_root), additionally shortened by an EOS that appears inside the reference prefix, and 0 when the root token is EOS
metric_definitions.L_tree_X: length of the longest correct-AR reference prefix that exists as a root-to-node path in tree X (root excluded)
metric_definitions.L_actual: number of tokens the target's greedy commit walk accepted along the tree, excluding the bonus token
metric_definitions.Delta_L_tree: L_tree_A1 - L_tree_A0 for the same anchor
metric_definitions.Phi_X: sum over nodes in tree X of exp(cumulative path log-probability), using only the persisted per-offset GPU log-probabilities
metric_definitions.first_missing_depth: 1-based offset of the first reference token not covered by the tree; null when the whole provided reference is covered
metric_definitions.early_region: depths 1..4 inclusive; the number of reference tokens at depths 1..4 that a tree covers is counted per anchor and summed per video
metric_definitions.recovered_paths: for the reference prefix: token offsets covered by A1 and not by A0
metric_definitions.lost_paths: for the reference prefix: token offsets covered by A0 and not by A1
metric_definitions.actual_nodes: len(nodes) actually built (may be < 63 when a depth or the parent pool runs out under A1)

statistical_units.anchor: one (video, saved C0 round index) pair; 48 in total, 44 with at least one predictive offset
statistical_units.aggregation_unit: video; the 8 anchors inside one video are nested and are never treated as independent samples
statistical_units.video_level: per-video mean or sum, then equal-weight average over the 6 videos
statistical_units.bootstrap: video-level resampling with replacement, seed 20261012, 2000 resamples, 2.5/97.5 percentiles
statistical_units.ci_interpretation: exploratory only for n=6; a CI that contains 0 does not establish equivalence

stage_0_gates.description: CPU replay of the frozen GPU candidates; any failure stops the A1 benefit claim
checks: A0 rebuild from persisted top8 ids/logp equals the stored 63-node tree on all 48 C0 anchors (token, depth, parent, rank)
per-anchor L_tree from an independent walk equals the recorded oracle.L_tree_oracle
recorded oracle.L_raw equals an independent recomputation of the top-8 reference coverage with the same cap/EOS rule
recorded oracle.L_actual equals an independent greedy commit walk over the stored tree using the recorded verification_argmax
sum over 48 anchors of (L_raw - L_tree) equals 40
mean over all 48 anchors of L_tree equals 2.8958333333333335
sum of commit_gap equals 0 and no anchor has a nonzero commit_gap
all 48 stored trees have exactly 63 nodes, parent < child index, depth = parent.depth + 1, and nodes drawn from their own offset candidate row
no record is substituted or dropped: the 48 anchors are exactly the C0 records of the frozen trace with the frozen (video, round_index) list

stage_1_gate_rules.note: all three must pass to proceed to Stage 2; these are resource filters, not significance tests; they were fixed before any A1 result was seen

gate_1_net_gain.statistic: sum over the 48 anchors of Delta_L_tree = L_tree_A1 - L_tree_A0

gate_2_not_single_video.statistic: per-video mean Delta_L_tree over that video's 8 anchors
gate_2_not_single_video.pass_if: at least 2 of the 6 videos have a strictly positive per-video mean

gate_3_early_coverage.statistic: per video: sum over anchors of (early reference tokens covered by A0) - (early reference tokens covered by A1), over depths 1..4
gate_3_early_coverage.threshold: T_v = 2 * (number of predictive anchors in video v) / 8, where a predictive anchor is one whose reference prefix is non-empty
gate_3_early_coverage.pass_if: no video has (A0 early covered - A1 early covered) > T_v
gate_3_early_coverage.reporting: per video the net early gain/loss, gross early gain, gross early loss, threshold, and a boolean severe_early_loss flag; anchors with an empty reference contribute 0 to both sides and are counted in the denominator only

stage_1_gate_rules.combined: Stage 2 runs only if gate_1 and gate_2 and gate_3 all pass

stage_2_plan.gate: per anchor L_actual_A1 must equal L_tree_A1; A0 must reproduce the persisted C6 verification argmax on the correct path; every A1 submission must be a prefix of an independent AR continuation; tree mask, positions, visibility and M-RoPE are checked
stage_2_plan.budget: at most 48 A1 tree verifications plus the A0 control verifications, serial under the shared flock lock
stage_2_plan.failure_handling: locate and fix correctness or numerical issues first (bounded attempts); a failed pilot is kept in a separate failed/ directory and never merged into the formal table

stage_3_plan.scope: the same 6 videos, full decode to EOS or the preset length cap, A0 and A1, 12 decodes total, every token AR-lossless (SPEC = AR)
stage_3_plan.timing: same GPU, same precision, same warmup, alternating A/B order, at least 3 repeats if resources allow; instrumentation time is never reported as speed; if external contention makes runs incomparable the speed verdict is 'inconclusive'
stage_3_plan.no_extension: no extension to 29 videos, no C1/C2, no new frozen test set

stop_rules.cpu_no_net_gain: stop this fixed-quota scheme for the write-up; do not tune the quota and do not open a second quota search
stop_rules.local_gain_but_no_online_gain: locate early path loss, trajectory change, overhead or implementation mismatch; do not retune the quota
stop_rules.online_tau_gain_without_comparable_speed: report mechanism evidence only, not an acceleration claim
stop_rules.implementation_gate_failure: fix the blocker first; do not extend to D4 or other hypotheses
